title: BST (Binary Search Trees)
definition: A BST is a binary tree where left child < parent and right child > parent.
intuition: Combines binary search behavior with dynamic insertion capability.
how_it_works: In-order traversal yields elements in sorted order. Searches narrow choice by half at each step.
when_to_use: When search, insertion, and deletion must be done on dynamic datasets.
when_not_to_use: When tree balancing isn't guaranteed (degenerates to O(n) list).
complexity: Search/Insert: O(log n) average, O(n) worst case
